description: This file contains JavaScript code implementing WebRTC peer connection management, including data channel creation, device connection handling, and signaling via a Controller class. It defines functions and classes for establishing and managing WebRTC data channels and media streams, as well as signaling logic for device connection setup.

classes.name: DeviceConnection
classes.description: Manages WebRTC data channels and media streams for a device, including signaling, media control, and data transfer.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Handles signaling exchange between the client and server for WebRTC connection setup, including processing offers, answers, and ICE candidates.

methods.name: createDataChannel
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC data channel with specified label and message handler.

methods.name: awaitDataChannel
methods.description: Waits for a data channel with a specific label to be opened.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Main exported function to establish a WebRTC connection with a device, returning a DeviceConnection object.
